brainlife.desc: HCP Pipelines PreFreeSurfer output folder. No registered App reads or writes it.
brainlife.name: neuro/hcp/freesurferpre
brainlife.readme:
**Use for:** Intermediate HCP structural preprocessing results.

**Not for:** No registered App uses this datatype; owner review needed.

**BIDS:** no BIDS counterpart.

**Sharing:** Tier 3 (directly identifiable or traceable) by default.

Full record: https://github.com/brainlife/abcd-spec/blob/master/datatypes/neuro.hcp.freesurferpre.json

identifying_risks: Includes whole-head T1w/T2w images with recognisable faces
sharing_cautions: Deface before sharing outside a controlled project
tier_conditions: Tier 2 once whole-head anatomical images are defaced or removed

sources: catalog/apps/<app_id>.json (manifests of the Apps in usage)
